BOLTS - Open Library of Technical Specifications - https://github.com/boltsparts/BOLTS_archive (GPL-3.0 for the tools; the data files
are LGPL 2.1+, copyright Johannes Reinhardt and contributors, see each file header and LICENSE). Copied unchanged: `bolttools/`
(the parser) and `data/` (all .blt and profile .yaml tables: fasteners, nuts, washers, rolled sections, pipes, flanges, bearings ...).
ShipBrain reads them through shipbrain/parts.py. The CAD back ends of BOLTS (FreeCAD, OpenSCAD ...) are not used.
